nodeTest.source: built into the recorded Node runtime

protocol.execution: serial synchronous passing cases; globally unique names; no parallel entrants
protocol.isolation: fresh Node worker and test child, or fresh Node worker plus isolated Chrome profile, per sample
protocol.timing: cold wall includes startup, execution, precise V8 coverage, validation, HTML/LCOV/JSON writes, and teardown
protocol.comparison: Node and browser are separate lanes; only comparable or richer runners are ranked
